disclaimer: MODELED values are transparent engineering judgments mapped from OBSERVED claims. Not scientifically calibrated. Capacity expansion, strategic importance, and supplier concentration alone are not treated as proof of current scarcity. Forward shortage estimates are discounted vs present observed constraints.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: Primary Broadcom materials tie AI cluster growth to 800G/1.6T module demand; TH6 production volume multiplies east-west optics attach.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: Only quantified shortage claim is secondary McKinsey-via-MLQ (800G/1.6T shortfalls through 2027–2029). Counted as partial present pressure, not full current observed shortfall. Still the strongest scarcity signal in this X-Ray.
observations.capacity_growth_rationale: DSP, laser, and module roadmaps expanding rapidly; growth real but lagging stated demand narratives.
observations.supplier_concentration_rationale: Module assembly has several vendors (Innolight et al.) but key subcomponents (DSP/EML) are concentrated.
observations.lead_time_pressure_rationale: Forward shortage estimates and AI optics allocation language imply extended lead times; primary lead-time data not disclosed.
observations.yield_risk_rationale: High-speed optics yield is non-trivial but not the primary public framing vs capacity.
observations.technology_maturity_rationale: 800G shipping; 1.6T entering with new 400G/lane DSP path — mid-high maturity.
observations.qualification_difficulty_rationale: Hyperscaler module qualification is multi-quarter and vendor-stick.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: CPO can reduce front-panel modules but is not yet a drop-in substitute at production scale.
observations.geographic_concentration_rationale: Module manufacturing concentrated in Asia; laser InP fabs more concentrated.
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: Without optics, 102.4T fabrics cannot leave the copper island.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: Strong primary demand; scarcity magnitude is secondary and partly forward-looking through 2027–2029.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: Required for pluggable 800G/1.6T modules and optical interconnects; Broadcom ships 200G EMLs in volume for AI optics.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: Primary evidence shows production shipping and InP capacity expansion — not a measured present shortfall. Expansion is not scored as scarcity. No primary quantified laser shortage found.
observations.capacity_growth_rationale: Broadcom states >3× YoY InP/EML/CW/VCSEL capacity build — growth is observed; constraint relief may be underway.
observations.supplier_concentration_rationale: InP EML supply is specialized, but secondary unique-supplier claims are not treated as proven industry monopoly. Broadcom itself ships millions of EMLs.
observations.lead_time_pressure_rationale: No primary public lead-time series for AI-grade lasers; moderate pressure only from specialized process, not from measured backlog.
observations.yield_risk_rationale: InP EML process is precision-limited; modeled structural risk without disclosed yield shortfalls.
observations.technology_maturity_rationale: 200G EML in production; 400G EML path paired to Taurus DSP still earlier.
observations.qualification_difficulty_rationale: Optical reliability qualification (FIT hours) is slow to transfer across suppliers.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: Reach-class lasers are not freely interchangeable (EML vs VCSEL/CW), but substitution difficulty is not proven extreme by primary shortage data.
observations.geographic_concentration_rationale: Broadcom cites US/Singapore InP ops; specialty InP capacity remains geographically limited.
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: Modules and optical paths depend on lasers; importance alone is not scored as scarcity.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: Primary proves demand and production; scarcity/concentration remain weakly evidenced (secondary or inferred).

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: Every 800G/1.6T module needs PAM4 DSP; Broadcom launching 200G and 400G/lane generations for AI.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: Broadcom ramping Sian3/Taurus; leadership ≠ proven industry-wide shortage, but AI attach is steep.
observations.capacity_growth_rationale: New 3nm DSP products entering production/availability quickly.
observations.supplier_concentration_rationale: High-end optical DSP market concentrated (Broadcom/Marvell class).
observations.lead_time_pressure_rationale: Advanced-node DSP ramps can constrain module builders during transitions.
observations.yield_risk_rationale: 3nm DSP complexity present but Broadcom claims production readiness.
observations.qualification_difficulty_rationale: Module makers qualify specific DSP+laser combinations.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: Limited second sources at leading PAM4 rates.
observations.geographic_concentration_rationale: Fabbed at advanced foundries; design concentration more than geography.
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: DSP power/BER performance gates module feasibility.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: Multiple Broadcom primary DSP announcements with concrete specs.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: CPO designs (Davisson 16×6.4T engines; NVIDIA Spectrum-X Photonics) raise engine demand if CPO adopts.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: CPO engines are vendor-integrated; volume not disclosed as commodity capacity.
observations.capacity_growth_rationale: Third-gen Broadcom CPO engines and multi-vendor CPO announcements.
observations.supplier_concentration_rationale: Engines tightly coupled to switch vendors today.
observations.lead_time_pressure_rationale: Custom engine attach and package qualification slow the ramp.
observations.yield_risk_rationale: Multi-engine package yield is a known CPO risk; prior gens cite extensive testing.
observations.technology_maturity_rationale: Shipping/sampling CPO but not proven at pluggable scale.
observations.qualification_difficulty_rationale: Hyperscaler CPO qualification and service model still emerging.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: Hard to swap engines across switch platforms.
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: Required for CPO path; less critical while pluggables dominate.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: Primary Davisson/NVIDIA CPO product claims; volume opaque.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: Positioned as response to SerDes power/reach and front-panel optics density; multi-vendor announcements, not yet universal demand.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: Announced shipping/sampling; public disclosures do not establish hyperscaler production volume.
observations.capacity_growth_rationale: Broadcom third-gen CPO + fourth-gen roadmap; NVIDIA Spectrum-X Photonics.
observations.lead_time_pressure_rationale: Qualification and reliability gates dominate timeline.
observations.yield_risk_rationale: Integrated optics + ASIC package raises yield/reliability stakes.
observations.technology_maturity_rationale: Technology transition — treat as emerging, not mature deployed capacity.
observations.qualification_difficulty_rationale: Serviceability and field reliability remain adoption gates.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: Pluggables remain the practical substitute today.
observations.geographic_concentration_rationale: Tied to advanced packaging and engine supply chains.
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: If CPO succeeds, it reshapes optics, packaging, lasers, and power.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: Primary product announcements strong; deployment scale still weakly evidenced.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: CPO and high-SerDes switches require package complexes beyond standard ASIC packages.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: Shared pressure with broader advanced packaging ecosystem; networking-specific capacity not separately disclosed.
observations.capacity_growth_rationale: CPO generations progressing; packaging capacity expansions industry-wide.
observations.supplier_concentration_rationale: Advanced packaging for leading CPO remains concentrated.
observations.yield_risk_rationale: Yield on large CPO packages is a modeled risk.
observations.technology_maturity_rationale: CPO packaging less mature than pluggable switch packages.
observations.qualification_difficulty_rationale: Package qualification coupled to optics reliability.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: Few alternative package flows for 16-engine CPO designs.
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: Gates CPO ramp; less binding while pluggables dominate.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: Structural from Davisson description; less direct packaging capacity evidence than CoWoS X-Ray.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: AI cluster scale-up/out drives 100T-class switch demand; TH6 deployed across hyperscalers per company claims.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: RED CELL: Broadcom states TH6 shipping in production volume — demand high, but this node is not modeled as the primary scarcity vs optics/lasers.
observations.capacity_growth_rationale: TH6 in volume; TH7 200T taped out per earnings commentary.
observations.supplier_concentration_rationale: High-end AI Ethernet switching concentrated (Broadcom leadership; NVIDIA Spectrum competing).
observations.lead_time_pressure_rationale: Production shipping reduces modeled lead-time pressure vs optics.
observations.yield_risk_rationale: Large ASIC yield risk exists but not the public bottleneck narrative.
observations.qualification_difficulty_rationale: Fabric software/qualification sticky but multi-vendor Ethernet paths exist.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: NVIDIA Spectrum and others compete; InfiniBand/proprietary scale-up can alter some paths.
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: Switch silicon sits at the root of fabric topology.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: Every high-radix AI switch depends on dense 100G/200G SerDes.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: SerDes ships with switch silicon; constraint is more reach/power than discrete SerDes chip scarcity.
observations.supplier_concentration_rationale: Leading SerDes IP concentrated in major networking silicon vendors.
observations.yield_risk_rationale: Signal integrity yields matter at board level.
observations.qualification_difficulty_rationale: System SI qualification required per platform.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: Copper reach can delay optics but cannot eliminate optics at cluster scale.
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: Defines copper island size and optics attach density.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: Broadcom states optical interconnect power major limiter of AI cluster scalability.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: Power budget scarcity at rack/row — not a discrete component shortage.
observations.capacity_growth_rationale: Facility power grows slower than networking bandwidth demand.
observations.supplier_concentration_rationale: Power is a facility constraint, not a single supplier.
observations.lead_time_pressure_rationale: Power delivery upgrades have long lead times.
observations.technology_maturity_rationale: Power engineering mature; density challenges rising.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: Lower-power DSP/CPO/copper can help but physics remains.
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: Caps how dense networking can get even if components exist.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: Direct primary Broadcom claim on optical interconnect power limiting scale.

observations.demand_pressure_rationale: Follows network power density as 800G→1.6T and CPO packages concentrate heat.
observations.capacity_pressure_rationale: Cooling capacity per rack is finite; liquid cooling expanding but not universal.
observations.capacity_growth_rationale: Liquid-cooled switch systems emerging in AI fabrics.
observations.supplier_concentration_rationale: Multiple cooling vendors; less concentrated than optics.
observations.yield_risk_rationale: Reliability/thermal failures more than fab yield.
observations.technology_maturity_rationale: Air cooling mature; high-density liquid still scaling.
observations.substitution_difficulty_rationale: Lower power helps; cooling still required.
observations.geographic_concentration_rationale: Cooling constraints are facility-local rather than concentrated in a single supplier geography.
observations.downstream_importance_rationale: Thermal limits package and port density.
observations.evidence_confidence_rationale: Mostly inferred from power claims and partner quotes; fewer direct thermal capacity numbers.
